  Georgia law requires that we notify tenants regarding the disposition of their security deposit after they move out.
Our Records indicate that you paid a deposit of $ 0.00 on the property you leased from Excalibur.

  Your current balance due is more than your Security Deposit amount. We have, therefore, applied the deposit to
outstanding charges. The remaining balance is still due as shown on the attached ledger.

  If you moved out prior to the end of your lease without the Landlord's consent then you owe rent through the end of the lease
  or until a new tenant moves in and starts paying rent. If this is your circumstance then the charges on the attached register
  show rent charged through the end of the lease. Once the property has been re-rented and we know the date that the new
  tenant starts paying rent, your charges for rent will be reduced accordingly.

  Please send in certified funds for payment in full or call to arrange a payment schedule within 30 days of the date of this letter.
  If we have not heard from you within 30 days the unpaid balance may be sent to a collection agency. This might have a
  negative impact on your credit rating.

  Please contact our office as soon as possible so that we may resolve this situation.

  •  Electrical failures: If all, or a portion of your home loses electricity, do the following before calling office:
  Check GFCI’s and try to push reset buttons (GFCI’S located in all wet areas – Kitchen’s, baths, and garage). If
  that does not remedy, check breaker box (see above for location) to see if any breakers were tripped –
  including main - and reset). If that doesn’t remedy, check with neighbors to see if there is an area outage. If
  all else fails, call office. If tenant found to have not checked breaker box or GFCI, Tenant will be
  charged for the repair/trip.
  •  Light Bulbs, smoke detector batteries: All light bulbs and smoke detector batteries have been installed
  and/or replaced before move in. Tenant is responsible for replacing light bulbs and smoke detector batteries
  throughout tenancy. If any light bulbs are not working during move in, please note on Inventory &
  Condition form provided to you and notify office.

  •  Garbage disposal issues: If garbage disposal fails, push reset button on bottom of unit. If it still does not
  turn on or you hear “humming”, call office. (NOTE: if plumber finds that a foreign object created a jam – ie,
  bones, glass, toys or anything other than what should be put in a garbage disposal, repair will be billed to
  tenant)

  •  AC or Heating failures: Call office so they can send a technician. Do not attempt to get on roof or tamper
  with AC or Furnace. Always prepare yourself for an emergency by keeping fans (summer) or portable
  heaters and blankets (winter) handy. We will do everything in our power to get units running promptly, but
  be prepared in case of delays due to weekends, holidays or parts availability.

  •  Heating & Cooling seasonal service & filters: A technician will be sent to your home at the start of spring
  season (March/April) and fall season (October/November) to service AC unit and Furnace/heating unit which
  include checking for carbon monoxide. See attached document for proper operation and maintenance for
